rationale: With only 26 minutes to close and price sitting at 82% of today's range near session highs, the risk/reward for a new position is unfavorable — a long risks being caught in late-day profit-taking while a short faces a stock that has already shown strong upward momentum today (up ~4% from open). The 5-minute ATR of ~$2.58 is very tight relative to the spread and the time remaining, making it difficult to capture meaningful movement before forced liquidation at close. No news catalyst and no clear technical setup with sufficient edge justify committing capital here.
